records.title: Setting-Up of ESI Hospital in Bhagalpur
details: a to e: ESIC has accorded "in principle" approval for setting up of a bedded, upgraded to 100-bedded, hospital at Bhagalpur, Bihar in March 2024. The State of Bhiar offered land for the said hospital. But the land was not found suitable. ESIC is pursuing with State Government for alternate suitable land.

records.title: Road Construction Connecting NH-80
details: a to c): As far as the connectivity between Pirpainti (NH-80) to Katihar is concerned, the work of 4- laning between Pirpainti to Sahebganj, along with construction of new bridge across river Ganga at Sahebganj to connect Katihar has been awarded.

records.title: Nuclear Energy Projects In Bihar
details: b to d: Department of Atomic Energy is exploring potential sites in Bihar for setting up nuclear power plants in the country.
